source_title: SCCM Guidelines on Recognizing and Responding to Clinical Deterioration Outside the ICU
clinical_context: Use when alerts imply the patient may need additional help or urgent bedside review.
key_points: The panel recommends hospital-wide rapid response or medical emergency teams with explicit activation criteria.
Rapid response systems should include quality-improvement processes.
This card supports escalation wording, not automatic activation or clinical decision replacement.

evidence_location.quote: hospital-wide deployment of a rapid response team or medical emergency team
